schema: CREATE TABLE actor_configs(actor TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(actor) REFERENCES actors(id))
CREATE TABLE actor_counts(kind INTEGER NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL,total INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(kind,role,active))
CREATE TABLE actor_personas(actor TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(actor) REFERENCES actors(id))

CREATE TABLE actor_selection(kind INTEGER NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(kind,role,active,ordinal),FOREIGN KEY(actor) REFERENCES actors(id))
CREATE TABLE actor_state(actor TEXT NOT NULL,key TEXT NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(actor,key),UNIQUE(actor,ordinal),FOREIGN KEY(actor) REFERENCES actors(id))
CREATE TABLE actors(ordinal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,driver TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL,data_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE "commons_counts"(receiver TEXT NOT NULL,round INTEGER NOT NULL,total INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(receiver,round))
CREATE TABLE "commons_head"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,current_round INTEGER NOT NULL,total_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL,inbox_after INTEGER NOT NULL,duration INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "commons_members"(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,group_no INTEGER NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,partner TEXT,round INTEGER NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(id) REFERENCES actors(id))
CREATE TABLE "commons_messages"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,sender TEXT NOT NULL,receiver TEXT NOT NULL,round INTEGER NOT NULL,timestamp REAL NOT NULL,body BLOB NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "commons_paired"(first TEXT NOT NULL,second TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(first,second))
CREATE TABLE "commons_partners"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,actor TEXT NOT NULL,partner TEXT NOT NULL,round INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "commons_schedule"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,round INTEGER NOT NULL,group_no INTEGER NOT NULL,first TEXT NOT NULL,second TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE result_chunks(set_id TEXT NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,chunk INTEGER NOT NULL,raw_start INTEGER NOT NULL,raw_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,payload BLOB NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(set_id,ordinal,chunk))
CREATE TABLE result_current_metrics(phase TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,set_id TEXT NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(phase,name))
CREATE TABLE result_phases(step INTEGER NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,header TEXT NOT NULL,elapsed_s REAL NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(step,ordinal))
CREATE TABLE result_rows(set_id TEXT NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,raw_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(set_id,ordinal))

CREATE TABLE result_sets(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,origin TEXT NOT NULL,step INTEGER NOT NULL,phase_index INTEGER NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL,finished INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE result_steps(step INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,time TEXT NOT NULL,phase_count INTEGER NOT NULL,activation_count INTEGER NOT NULL,elapsed_s REAL NOT NULL,capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,max_activations INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE result_totals(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,value INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "work_counts"(receiver TEXT NOT NULL,round INTEGER NOT NULL,total INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(receiver,round))
CREATE TABLE "work_head"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,current_round INTEGER NOT NULL,total_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL,inbox_after INTEGER NOT NULL,duration INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "work_members"(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,group_no INTEGER NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,partner TEXT,round INTEGER NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(id) REFERENCES actors(id))
CREATE TABLE "work_messages"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,sender TEXT NOT NULL,receiver TEXT NOT NULL,round INTEGER NOT NULL,timestamp REAL NOT NULL,body BLOB NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "work_paired"(first TEXT NOT NULL,second TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(first,second))
CREATE TABLE "work_partners"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,actor TEXT NOT NULL,partner TEXT NOT NULL,round INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "work_schedule"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,round INTEGER NOT NULL,group_no INTEGER NOT NULL,first TEXT NOT NULL,second TEXT NOT NULL)
